title: Vanishing of cohomology on affine schemes
statement:
Let $X=\Spec A$ be affine. For every quasi-coherent
$\cO_X$-module $\cF$ and every $q>0$: $H^q(X,\cF)=0$.

proof.text: Apply [lem-pc-affine-vanishing] to the given affine scheme $X=\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ and the given quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal F$. Its conclusion is $H^p(X,\mathcal F)=0$ for every $p>0$. Taking $p=q$ gives the assertion. The hypotheses and the cohomology functor are identical; no finiteness, noetherianity or separatedness assumption is added.
